name: Seth
summary: The son born to Adam and Eve after Cain killed Abel. After his son Enos was born, men began to call on the name of the LORD.

key_moments.title: Born in Abel's Place
key_moments.description: Eve bore another son and named him Seth, saying God had given her another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain killed. Adam was a hundred and thirty years old, and Seth was born in his likeness, after his image.

key_moments.title: Names His Son Enos
key_moments.description: When Seth was a hundred and five years old, a son was born to him, and he called him Enos. Then men began to call on the name of the LORD.

key_moments.title: Dies at 912 Years Old
key_moments.description: After Enos was born, Seth lived eight hundred and seven more years and had sons and daughters. All his days were nine hundred and twelve years, and he died.
